children: Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT) (“Solmate” or the “Company”) today announced that members of its management team will participate in a live panel at Solana Capital Forum Singapore on October 6, during TOKEN2049 week.

The panel will examine the growing role of public markets in financing companies across the Solana ecosystem and how listed companies can provide investors with transparent, institutionally accessible exposure to the network’s growth. Solmate management will discuss the evolution of public-market treasury strategies, institutional participation and long-term capital formation.

Solmate invites investors and other interested parties attending TOKEN2049 week to join the discussion in Singapore. Attendance is subject to the event organizer’s registration and approval process. Additional information will be available through the

The event follows a substantial increase in the estimated market value of Solmate’s treasury. Based on public data as of September 18th, as presented on the company’s dashboard, the Company’s treasury was estimated to be valued at approximately $141 million, compared with approximately $88 million in July 2026, an increase of more than 60%.

Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT) is building next-generation digital infrastructure spanning blockchain and staking. The Company is focused on creating long-term shareholder value through the ownership, operation and optimization of mission-critical digital infrastructure assets. For more information, visit
